title: Elephantine Spellcaster
description: A hooded elephant-headed figure with long tusks, adorned in ornate robes and gold jewelry, holds an open spellbook emitting smoke while standing beside a black mound topped with lit candles and scarab beetles. Several white-robed human figures perform a ritual at the base of the mound under a background of glowing orbs.
prompt: A detailed ink illustration of a tall hooded elephant-headed figure with long tusks and multiple gold rings and bracelets, wearing ornate robes, holding an open magical book with smoke and scarab symbols rising from it. The figure stands next to a large black mound covered in lit candles and scarab beetles, with several white-robed human worshippers performing a ritual at its base, glowing orbs floating in the background, mystical and occult atmosphere, black and white with gold accents
